title: AP, Telangana to receive intense rains amid depression in Bay of Bengal - The Hans India
full_text:
Heavy clouds have been seen forming over Telugu states as a depression has formed over the Bay of Bengal. Apart from it, there is also the possibility of rough seas due to the formation of the depression. The Meteorological Department has noted that the depression will continue to grow in strength and will turn into a deep depression in 24 hours resulting in widespread rains.
Prakhar Jain the Managing Director of State Disaster Management Authority has said that the depression has been spotted over the Northwest Bay of Bengal and coastal areas of Odisha and West Bengal yesterday. He noted that the depression is moving towards west-north direction and is expected to become a deep depression within 24 hours.
The depression is expected to hit Paradip and Sagar Island in the coastal areas of North Odisha-West Bengal tomorrow. This will result in rough seas. Therefore, people are told not to send small boats (under seven meters) in the sea. The fishermen were advised not to venture into the sea till Wednesday.
Light to moderate rains are expected in parts of Andhra Pradesh on Monday especially in Vizianagaram, Srikakulam, Alluri, Manyam, Polavaram, Konaseema, and Visakhapatnam. There may be strong winds blowing with speeds of 55–65 kmph in the North Andhra region; people are being warned.
On the other hand, the Meteorological Centre, Hyderabad, has forecasted heavy rains in next three days in Telangana state. Heavy rains likely in the capital of Hyderabad, Peddapalli, Jayashankar Bhupalpally, Khammam, Mulugu, Asifabad, Mancherial, and Bhadradri Kothagudem.
